summary: fix(sylveste-2d9): make .beads/push.sh portable across Mac + Linux
expected_findings_themes: shell script depends on BASH_SOURCE which is non-portable to POSIX sh
env-var escape hatches without input validation widen the attack surface
command -v dolt resolution silently picks up a wrong dolt on PATH if user shadowing exists
rationale: Bash refactor with portability concerns and new env-var inputs. fd-quality on shell idioms, fd-correctness on cross-platform path derivation edge cases, fd-safety on env-var escape hatches.
labeler_notes: Both backends should agree this needs shell-aware review.
